occurrences.text: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
